decision: measured the code against the cognitive gate before planning
why: wanted the size of the retrofit before starting
result: 23 functions over 15, worst is update at 422; main.rs 7384 lines against a 1000 cap

decision: treat crates/epaint and crates/egui_commonmark as vendored third-party code and move them to vendor/
why: they are upstream forks outside the cargo workspace; full-lint's file-length gate skips vendor/ by design; retrofitting 28.7k forked lines would triple the work
result: open: user can ask for the fork to be gated too

decision: copied the full-lint Rust templates, moved the vendored forks to vendor/, swapped setsid for process_group so unsafe can be forbidden
why: the gates need their config in place before any code moves

decision: made typos, markdownlint, jscpd, gitleaks, shellcheck, shfmt, yamllint, actionlint pass; link check verified offline only
why: these gates do not touch src so they could run while the split was in flight; the sandbox proxy returns 403 for github.com pages
result: 8 gates pass locally; remote link check INCONCLUSIVE here

decision: split main.rs and system_fonts.rs into 44 files with a generator script, every test in its own tests.rs
why: file cap is 1000 effective lines and the house rule bans tests beside code
result: pure move: 7 lines gone, 35 added beyond framing, all explained; 83 tests same names, 76/2/5 same result

decision: allowed unwrap, expect and panic inside tests through clippy.toml, and allowed redundant_pub_crate and multiple_crate_versions in the lint table
why: a failed unwrap in a test is the assertion; the two clippy lints contradict unreachable_pub and duplicate cargo-deny
result: open: the user may prefer zero exceptions

decision: handed lint and complexity cleanup to three agents on disjoint files in separate worktrees
why: 25 functions over the cap and about 300 findings split cleanly by file

decision: updated six crates with fixes, ignored four advisories with dated reasons, listed 66 duplicate crates as exact skips, pointed osv-scanner at the root lockfile
why: the GUI, math and diagram stacks pin versions this manifest cannot choose; the vendored lockfiles do not ship
result: cargo-deny x3, osv x2, shear pass; first license run was a false pass with an empty list, rerun with a failing control

decision: merged the three lint branches and reran every code gate myself on the merged tree
why: each agent could only see its own files compile; 23 float comparisons in tests surfaced only after the merge
evidence: commits 88489dd 5d5bedf and the merge of unit A; commit with test_support.rs
result: clippy, doc, fmt, arborist, line gate all exit 0; 149 tests pass, 0 fail, 5 ignored

decision: accepted two fixes the agents made beyond pure refactor: one Alt+arrow keypress now moves one history step, and history navigation updates the title, explorer highlight and watched file
why: both were real bugs with a test that failed on the old code

decision: measured coverage after lint work, then split the gap across three agents by file group
why: baseline moved from 33% to 66% lines; the rest is UI code reachable with the headless harness
